Name: Custom Community Center Bundles
Author: Jaksha6472
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/kArcauI.png[/img][/center]
[center][size=3][color=#dd643a]This is the EASY VERSION of this mod. If you're looking for more difficult bundles, you can find them here:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6361]Challenging Community Center Bundles[/url][/color][/size][/center]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/br9RloX.png[/img][/center]

[center][color=#c9b490][size=3]This overhaul attempts to create a more vanilla style but not frustrating experience fulfilling the community center bundles while also providing more variety to these.[/size][/color][/center]

[center][color=#c9b490][size=3]Included are special rewards for fulfilling the bundles and even bundle variants for the remixed bundle versions! We tried to stay as close as possible to the vanilla experience for this. All bundles should be relatively easy to fulfill.[/size][/color][/center]

[center][color=#c9b490][size=3]Have fun experiencing a vanilla style game experience with all your favorite mods![/size][/color][/center]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/4HgJ9np.png[/img][/center]
[list][color=#c9b490][size=3][*]Download and install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*]If you're using the [b]"Custom Cornucopia"[/b], [b]"Custom Cornucopia RSV"[/b], [b]"Custom Cornucopia SVE"[/b] or [b]"Custom Cornucopia RSV SVE"[/b] bundle variant:
[list]
[*]Download and install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops (Only Essential Pack needed)[/url]
[*]Download and install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flowers (Only Essential Pack needed)[/url]
[*]Download and install all necessary dependencies of these mods
[/list]
[*]If you're using the [b]"[color=#c9b490][size=3][b]Custom [/b][/size][/color]RSV"[/b], [b]"[color=#c9b490][size=3][b]Custom [/b][/size][/color]Cornucopia RSV"[/b], [b]"Custom RSV SVE"[/b] or [b]"Custom Cornucopia RSV SVE"[/b] bundle variant:
[list]
[*]Download and install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]
[*]Download and install all necessary dependencies of this mod
[/list]
[*]If you're using the [b]"Custom SVE"[/b], [b]"Custom Cornucopia SVE"[/b], [b]"Custom RSV SVE"[/b] or [b]"Custom Cornucopia RSV SVE"[/b] bundle variant:
[list]
[*]Download and install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]
[*]Download and install all necessary dependencies of this mod
[/list]
[*]Download the latest version of <YourChosenBundleVariant> in the download section and unzip it, then copy
[list]
[*][code]Custom Community Center Bundles[/code]
[/list]into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory.
[*]You're done; run the game using SMAPI! Enjoy!
[/size][/color][/list]


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/lz3OBZw.png[/img][/center]


[color=#c9b490][size=3]Under some circumstances your savegame might be affected by the changes of this bundle mod. To revert the changes follow the following guideline:

[list]
[*]Set the CustomCommuntyCenterBundles config to [code]"Pure_Vanilla"[/code]
[*]The config can be found in the CustomCommuntyCenterBundles folder
[*]Load your affected savegames and play at least one day till the game saved the changes
[*]This will reset all bundle entries in the savegame to the pure vanilla counterparts
[*]After that please delete all reminders of this mod
[/list][/size][/color]


[center][size=3][color=#c9b490]This mod will always be open source, you can check the source code on [url=https://github.com/Jaksha6472/ChallengingCommunityCenterBundles]GitHub[/url].[/color][/size][/center]
